body:
@pixelastic The proposed API in #41 had `template` and `cssClass` in it, what about them? Do you implement them also?

About `template`: we could maybe have a default template, use it if no provided template. Otherwise use the provided template (like for multipleChoiceList).

> Oh, and as the instant search demo does not have any boolean attributes, there is no way to test it here. I tested on a custom index on my side.

It did have something like a switch at some point when we did the API proposal, in #41 there's a screenshot but now it's no more on the demo. Yes for adding it to the data.
